description: Published FC last-trading/first-notice dates for a product and optional YYYYMM delivery month (default next published month). Never runs an expiry engine; unpublished months are unknown with a product-page link. Official exchange notices take precedence.

month.description: Delivery month as six digits YYYYMM with month 01-12, e.g. 202612; omitted = earliest published month at or after the current exchange-local month, falling back to the current month if none is published (unpublished dates remain unknown).

product.description: FC product slug with two alphanumeric segments separated by one hyphen, at most 40 characters, e.g. shfe-cu or nymex-cl; case-insensitive and normalized to lowercase, with no default when required.

name: contract_expiry
